desc:
🌊 CLIMB FAST. STAY ABOVE THE FLOOD. REACH THE TOP!

Race through 19 towers as the water rises! Pick Easy or Hard, slap rivals, use tactical items, or climb at your own pace.

🏰 19 unique towers with Easy & Hard courses
🥊 11 slap weapons + 8 tactical items
🌦️ Dynamic weather with Cheer Point bonuses
🎉 CHEER RAIN & BOX RAIN reward events
👀 Spectate for Cheer Points, take a seat for a boost, then shop or spin
🥔 Deliver fruit, meet the Potato Engineer, and unlock rare rewards
🦉 Explore the Owl tower and chase a special Owl UGC
🌍 Per-map world record tracking is now in testing
🏆 Earn Trophies, Medals, Coins, Keys, Fame, and ranks
✨ Collect 56 Trails, 25 Scuba Gear pieces, emotes, and more
✅ Complete 47 Achievements, Daily Quests, Daily Rewards, and Training Towers
🎁 Limited UGC events return—join seasonal rankings and challenges for exclusive avatar items!

Quick to play, endlessly replayable, and better with friends. Outrun the flood and reach the top!
